learningObjectives: Explain application and production Rulesets in a scenario.
Explain Ruleset validation in a scenario.
Explain the Ruleset list in a scenario.

elements.description: Rulesets package related Rules. Application Rulesets define application behavior; organizational Rulesets support reuse. Int conventionally groups integration Rules. Production Rulesets support controlled maintenance in production, including delegation; keep a version unlocked and give intended operators access through their Access Groups.

elements.text: Worked example: Compliance staff maintain a delegated threshold in PolicyProd. Keep its editable version unlocked and configure the application plus the authorized Access Group.

elements.description: AV validates references against the defining application and its built-on stack. RV uses explicit version prerequisites and their prerequisites; prerequisite cycles are invalid. Validation happens at design time, not as runtime ranking. Use RV for portable shared assets. Revalidate after changes to built-on applications or the Ruleset list.

elements.text: Worked example: An RV integration module cannot reference a consumer-specific Rule merely because one developer can run that consumer. Its prerequisites must supply the dependency.

elements.description: At login, Pega starts from the Access Group’s versioned application and walks its built-on applications to assemble the runtime stack. Higher entries have precedence within Rule resolution. Eligible developers also get a personal Ruleset for checked-out Rules at the top. Inspect Operator Profile when two users see different behavior.

elements.text: Worked example: User One checks out a Rule; User Two does not. Compare their stack contexts before blaming the released Rule.

examPitfalls.title: Design vs execution
examPitfalls.trapDescription: RV decides which Rule wins at run time.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use validation for dependencies and the runtime stack for execution.

examPitfalls.title: Production access
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Application registration automatically grants access to everyone.

examPitfalls.title: Dependency direction
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A reusable lower application can reference any consuming application.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Keep references within the defining application and allowed dependencies.
